name: 1999TOKOYO Building
source:
1999. The protagonist, a boy named Akira, finds himself lost in the TOKOYO Building—an indoor amusement park filled with secrets and eerie rumors. There, he begins living and working alongside its peculiar staff, but... Did you know? People disappear in the TOKOYO Building.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4099810]Steam[/url]]
translation:
1999年，主角，一个名叫Akira的男孩，发现自己迷失在东京大厦——一个充满秘密和怪异谣言的室内游乐园。在那里，他开始与奇特的员工一起生活和工作，但是……你知道吗？人们在东京大厦消失。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4099810]Steam[/url]]
